# PreceptorOS · local-first AI

Four core repositories: WEB, APP, LAB, STUDY. Code and tests are public. Claims are measured or NO_DATA with a cause.

- WEB: https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/preceptoros-web
- APP: https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/preceptoros-app
- LAB: https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/lab
- STUDY: https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/study
- BABEL: https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/babel
- Public Mesa: https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/preceptoros-public-mesa
- Private Mesa: restricted preceptor review. It is not required for public work.

Preceptors: read AGENTS.md and source SHA before writing. Renaming Law: one English name, old aliases retained. Rosetta: Study/13-rosetta.md; Babel is the vocabulary home. GitHub PRs need tests and a human sign-off for the exact head. Public Mesa catalogs are draft; WEB section 9 remains the mission source. No agent signs.

DEPTH: Study/08-ai-fluency.md. Unsupported: NO_DATA with cause.
